description: Shared cases for every reader of the llm-kit project model file and its personal layer. Each case has a tracked input and may have a local input. An input is 'lines' (join with LF and add one final LF), 'text' (encode as UTF-8) or 'base64' (the exact bytes). Read the tracked bytes as the format says and run portable validation; when the case has a local input, read it and run portable validation of the personal layer against the tracked document, then resolve the selections. 'expect' is one of: {document} (the normalized tracked document); {local, resolved} (the normalized personal layer and the resolved selections); {error: {layer, code, path}} (the first problem; 'schema', when present, says whether the layer's JSON Schema accepts or refuses the parsed data, which shows the reader rules the schema cannot state). A valid case's parsed data and normalized result conform to the schema. Compare JSON values; object key order does not count. The contract is docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

cases.name: minimal
cases.note: Only version is required; catalog and selections default to empty.

cases.name: full-document
cases.note: Every field. Selections are keyed by any non-empty text; an omitted effort is null.

cases.name: omitted-versus-empty-efforts
cases.note: A row that omits efforts does not narrow the menu: portable validation accepts any non-empty effort (binding checks the library menu). A row with efforts [] has no effort: its selections must carry null. The normalized row keeps the difference (no efforts key versus []).

cases.name: omitted-versus-null-effort
cases.note: An omitted effort, null, ~ and Null all mean no effort and normalize to null.

cases.name: byte-order-mark
cases.note: A leading UTF-8 byte order mark is skipped.

cases.name: crlf-line-ends
cases.note: CRLF line ends read as LF.

tracked.text:
version: 1
catalog:
  - id: a
    label: A
    endpoint: api
    model: vendor/a

cases.name: cr-line-ends
cases.note: Lone CR line ends read as LF (YAML 1.1 line breaks).

tracked.text: version: 1catalog:  - id: a    label: A    endpoint: api    model: vendor/a

cases.name: anchors-and-aliases
cases.note: An alias stands for a copy of its anchored value.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-integer-forms
cases.note: YAML 1.1 integers: 0x10000 is 65536, 0100 is octal 64, 65_536 is 65536, 1:30 is base 60 (90). 019 and 0o17 are not YAML 1.1 integers, so they are strings.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-words
cases.note: y and n are strings (only yes/no/on/off/true/false are booleans); a quoted word stays a string; !!str keeps a date as text.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-float-forms
cases.note: YAML 1.1 floats need a dot, and an exponent needs a sign: 1.0e+3 is 1000.0, but 1.0e3 and 1e3 are strings.

cases.name: largest-exact-integers
cases.note: Integers up to 2**53 - 1 in magnitude are held exactly by every reader.

cases.name: reserved-extras-are-binding
cases.note: Portable validation accepts any extras key. Binding refuses keys the call owns (model, messages, stream, api_key, reasoning_effort).

cases.name: unicode-text
cases.note: Text is Unicode; keys and values may hold any character.

cases.name: comments-and-flow-style
cases.note: Comments are ignored; flow and block style read the same.

lines: catalog: [{id: a, label: A, endpoint: api, model: vendor/a}]

cases.name: empty-catalog-and-selections
cases.note: Explicit empty values are the same as omitted ones.

cases.name: block-scalars
cases.note: Literal (|), folded (>) and strip (|-) block scalars follow YAML chomping rules.

cases.name: local-override-wins
cases.note: A local entry that differs from the tracked one replaces it whole.

cases.name: local-only-key
cases.note: A key only the local layer names is an override with no default.

cases.name: local-equal-override
cases.note: A local entry equal to the tracked one is no override: the source stays default.

cases.name: local-omitted-effort-equals-null
cases.note: An omitted effort equals a null effort, so this entry is no override.

cases.name: local-empty
cases.note: A personal layer with no selections changes nothing.

cases.name: local-unknown-model
cases.note: A local selection must name a tracked catalog id.

cases.name: local-with-catalog
cases.note: The personal layer holds no catalog.

cases.name: local-missing-version
cases.note: The personal layer needs version 1.

cases.name: local-effort-not-declared
cases.note: A local effort must be in the tracked row's declared efforts.

cases.name: local-boolean-effort
cases.note: YAML 1.1 reads off as false, which is not an effort.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-on-is-true
cases.note: YAML 1.1 reads on as true; quote the word.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-yes-in-efforts
cases.note: YAML 1.1 reads yes as true.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-off-as-selection-key
cases.note: YAML 1.1 reads the key off as false; a key must be text.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-date-label
cases.note: YAML 1.1 reads 2026-11-13 as a date, which is not text.

cases.name: yaml-1.1-timestamp-in-extras
cases.note: A timestamp is not JSON data.

cases.name: duplicate-top-level-key
cases.note: A duplicate key is refused, not resolved to the last value.

cases.name: duplicate-selection-key
cases.note: A duplicate key is refused at any depth.

cases.name: duplicate-key-in-extras
cases.note: A duplicate key is refused inside free-form values too.

cases.name: merge-key
cases.note: Merge keys (<<) are refused; write the keys out.

cases.name: omap
cases.note: !!omap is not JSON data.

cases.name: pairs
cases.note: !!pairs is not JSON data.

cases.name: set
cases.note: !!set is not JSON data.

cases.name: binary
cases.note: !!binary is not JSON data.

cases.name: alias-cycle
cases.note: A value that holds itself through an alias is refused at the alias.

cases.name: integer-above-exact-range
cases.note: 2**53 is outside the range every JSON reader holds exactly.

cases.name: integer-below-exact-range
cases.note: -(2**53) is outside the exact range.

cases.name: max-output-tokens-above-exact-range
cases.note: max_output_tokens is at most 2**53 - 1.

cases.name: max-output-tokens-decimal
cases.note: 65536.0 is a decimal, not an integer, in the file (a JSON reader may see 65536).

cases.name: max-output-tokens-zero
cases.note: max_output_tokens is at least 1.

cases.name: infinity
cases.note: .inf is not a JSON number.

cases.name: overflow-to-infinity
cases.note: 1.0e+400 overflows to infinity, which is not a JSON number.

cases.name: not-a-number
cases.note: .nan is not a JSON number.

cases.name: malformed-utf-8
cases.note: Bytes that are not UTF-8 are refused.

cases.name: utf-8-surrogate
cases.note: An encoded surrogate (ED A0 80) is not UTF-8.

cases.name: utf-16
cases.note: UTF-16 is not UTF-8.

cases.name: control-character
cases.note: YAML refuses control characters such as U+0007 in the text.

tracked.text:
version: 1
catalog:
  - id: ab
    label: A
    endpoint: api
    model: vendor/a

cases.name: empty-file
cases.note: An empty file is refused.

cases.name: comment-only-file
cases.note: A file with no document is refused.

cases.name: two-documents
cases.note: The file holds one YAML document.

cases.name: not-yaml
cases.note: Text that is not YAML is refused.

cases.name: top-level-list
cases.note: The document is a mapping.

cases.name: unknown-top-level-key
cases.note: Only version, catalog and selections are allowed.

cases.name: missing-version
cases.note: version is required.

cases.name: version-2
cases.note: version must be 1.

cases.name: version-string
cases.note: version is an integer, not text.

cases.name: version-decimal
cases.note: version is the integer 1, not the decimal 1.0.

cases.name: version-true
cases.note: true is not 1.

cases.name: catalog-null
cases.note: catalog is a list.

cases.name: row-unknown-key
cases.note: A row holds only id, label, endpoint, model, efforts, max_output_tokens and request_defaults.

cases.name: row-missing-label
cases.note: id, label, endpoint and model are required.

cases.name: duplicate-id
cases.note: Catalog ids are unique.

cases.name: label-with-outer-space
cases.note: Text has no leading or trailing whitespace.

cases.name: empty-model
cases.note: Text is not empty.

cases.name: efforts-not-a-list
cases.note: efforts is a list.

cases.name: efforts-repeat
cases.note: An efforts list has no repeats.

cases.name: efforts-empty-word
cases.note: An effort is non-empty text.

cases.name: request-defaults-unknown-key
cases.note: request_defaults holds only extras.

cases.name: extras-not-a-mapping
cases.note: extras is a mapping.

cases.name: extras-integer-key
cases.note: A mapping key is text.

cases.name: selections-not-a-mapping
cases.note: selections is a mapping.

cases.name: selection-null
cases.note: A selection is a mapping.

cases.name: selection-unknown-model
cases.note: A selection names a catalog id.

cases.name: selection-missing-model
cases.note: model is required.

cases.name: selection-unknown-key
cases.note: A selection holds only model and effort.

cases.name: effort-not-in-declared-efforts
cases.note: When the row declares efforts, the effort is one of them.

cases.name: effort-on-row-with-empty-efforts
cases.note: A row with efforts [] takes no effort.

cases.name: empty-effort
cases.note: An effort is non-empty text or null.

cases.name: selection-key-with-outer-space
cases.note: A selection key has no leading or trailing whitespace.
